en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2188 - Indeed, on that night (the eve of Arafah), the gates of the heavens are not closed to the voices of the believers, whose supplications resound like the buzzing of bees.
Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, says: 'I am your Lord (azj), and you are My servants.

You have fulfilled My right, and it is incumbent upon Me to answer you.'
On that night, He (swt) removes the sins of those whom He (swt) wills and then forgives those whom He (swt) wills to forgive.
